details:
Steps to reproduce:

1. Start VRChat from the Steam library (Play button).

2. The Easy Anti-Cheat bootstrapper downloads the 38.5 MB module and initialises normally.

3. The bootstrapper then shows "Startup error - Cannot run under Virtual Machine" and exits

   with code 206. VRChat.exe is never created, so no game output log is produced for the

   attempt.

In my case the game does not launch at all, and I have seen the same result on every attempt

since 2026-11-01.

Why I think it may be a false positive:

- Intel NUC X15 (LAPKC71E), i7-11800H, RTX 3060 Laptop, Windows 11 25H2 build 26200.9711.

- TPM 2.0 ready and Secure Boot enabled.

- Win32_ComputerSystem.HypervisorPresent = False; VBS disabled; Hyper-V, Virtual Machine

  Platform, WSL and Windows Sandbox are not installed.

- CoreInfo v4.02 at CPUID level reports "HYPERVISOR -" (no hypervisor present), with VT-x and

  EPT present.

- VirtualBox and VMware software, kernel drivers and virtual devices have all been removed,

  and I verified they are gone. No VM drivers are loaded and no VM devices remain.

Things I have already tried, all with the same result: a full EAC uninstall and reinstall

(services, program folder and %APPDATA% removed first), Steam file revalidation, running the

launcher as administrator, fully removing the third-party antivirus, removing all

VirtualBox/VMware components, and several reboots.

I did contact VRChat support first (ticket 2Z7XJ0-XG37V). They were kind enough to check the

launcher log and confirmed it shows 206, and they explained that support is not able to clear

device-side verdicts. That is why I am posting here: as far as I can tell, this looks like the

VM check returning the wrong result for a physical machine, and I would be grateful if someone

could take a look. I am happy to provide any logs or captures that would help.

EAC bootstrapper log, service.log and a directory listing are available on request.
title: EAC 206 blocks launch on a genuine physical machine (possible false VM detection)
